name: Love Of God The
overview: Scripture reveals the love of God as sovereign and unmerited, demonstrated through His election and mercy rather than human works, as seen in Romans 9 where God loved Jacob but not Esau, establishing His purpose according to His calling. Titus highlights that God's love appeared toward mankind in kindness, not by our righteousness but through His mercy, which brings salvation by the regenerating work of the Holy Spirit poured out abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior. This love is both the foundation of our adoption into God's family and the means by which He draws sinners to Himself, emphasizing its gracious and everlasting nature.
